Release-sheet slip of [[Rebel Aces]] (original text), the whole slip: Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010), page 8, slip position 45 (the slip prints no number). The slip leaves the art window white, as the sheet does for every slip (it was printed to sleeve over the card [[I'll Take The Leader]], named in the bottom strip).

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=8 VirtualBlock7_1.pdf], page 8 (PDF SHA-1 f9aefb67e3e57a70ac57d1ad2f55745d1dc91e28, fetched 27 November 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive].

Edits: page rendered at 600 dpi (pdftoppm) and cropped to the slip's outer border; no other edits. Replaces the older crop [[:File:VB7-02-Rebel_Aces.png]], which stops below the art window and so shows no game text.
